people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Haran
people.line: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

translations.web: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
translations.bsb: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
translations.kjv: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
translations.asv: So Abram went, as Jehovah had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
